name: Get events
sql: SELECT * FROM events WHERE chain = $1 AND pair = $2 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT $3;

name: Get wallets
sql: SELECT * FROM events WHERE chain = $1 AND pair = $2 AND maker = ANY($3::text[]) ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT $4;

name: Count swaps
sql: SELECT * FROM events WHERE chain = $1 AND pair = $2 AND maker = ANY($3::text[]) ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT $4;

name: Flight candle
sql: SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', bucket) AS rb, first(open_usd, bucket) AS open_usd, max(high_usd) AS high_usd, min(low_usd) AS low_usd, last(close_usd, bucket) AS close_usd, sum(volume_usd) AS volume_usd FROM candles_1m WHERE chain = $1 AND pair = $2 AND bucket >= time_bucket('1 hour', now()) GROUP BY rb;

name: Last candles 1m
sql: SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', bucket) AS rb, first(open_usd, bucket) AS open_usd, max(high_usd) AS high_usd, min(low_usd) AS low_usd, last(close_usd, bucket) AS close_usd, sum(volume_usd) AS volume_usd FROM candles_1m_unified WHERE chain = $1 AND pair = $2 GROUP BY rb ORDER BY rb DESC LIMIT $3;
